results.summary: The player has no gold balance, the status text has no gold line, and no gold purse is spawned in the barracks. Only the map data defines a barracks node.

evidence.note: searched 'gold', 'purse', 'barracks' across Source/DelveDeeperTest; no hits. Status lines show only puzzle, quest and location.
enum has Carving, Control, Figure, StoreroomDoor only; no purse kind.

results.score_reason: Gold is the currency (GDD line 319) and DD-TOLL-02 cannot be paid or tested without it. It has no dependencies, and the code has no gold state at all.

results.summary: No bandit boss interactable exists. Nothing is spawned at boss_room, nothing reads bandit_strings.csv or faction_stages.json, and there is no toll prompt. The map defines boss_room, and Tick only tracks arrival at nodes.

evidence.note: searched 'boss', 'toll', 'bandit', 'boss_room', 'adventurer_name'; no hits. BeginPlay spawns only carving, controls, figure and storeroom door.
switch handles only the four existing kinds, so there is no boss prompt or pay hint.

results.score_reason: The boss is the centre of the toll encounter (GDD lines 385-387). DD-TOLL-02 and DD-DESC-01 depend on it, and it has no dependencies. Nothing in the code exists yet, and it also needs a CSV and JSON loader for the crew inputs.

results.summary: There is no pay action, no toll-paid state, and no cannot-pay or toll-paid strings. HandleInteract has no boss case, and Q (alt interact) is already routed to the director for use as pay. It is blocked by the unbuilt gold and boss requirements.

evidence.note: searched 'toll_paid', 'cannot_pay', 'bandit_boss_toll_paid_01', 'Pay'; no hits. The bAlt parameter exists and could carry pay.
run-state flags live in the director; no bTollPaid or gold member exists.

results.score_reason: Paying is the core of the milestone and DD-DESC-01 needs it (GDD 385-390). It cannot be built until DD-GOLD-01 and DD-TOLL-01 are implemented, so urgency is a notch lower, and the code has nothing for it.

results.summary: No descent interactable exists and nothing ends the demo or shows a win message. The map has a descent node and the floor builds it as a walkable slab, but no code at all handles it.

evidence.note: searched 'descent', 'win', 'victory', 'barred'; no hits. Nothing is spawned at the descent node.
HUD draws only status lines and messages; there is no win banner and no input-stop logic in DDDemoCharacter.

results.score_reason: The win and descent are the demo's ending (GDD 44-45, 390) and central to the milestone. It depends on DD-TOLL-02, so it cannot start first, and nothing depends on it.
